Live Monitoring

Approve a computer

Cloud connection updates every 30 seconds while you are viewing this page. Your parent computer does not need to stay on. School time received is not verified lesson completion.

Messages

Private conversations with cloud test children. Attach an image, PDF or audio file up to 2 MB. Received means the message reached the computer, not that its attachment was opened. Existing LAN conversations and microphone recording are still being transferred.

Conversations

Select a student to view messages.

Screenshots

Not connected to cloud yet

Screenshots is still available in your current Admin app. Its existing screen and functions will be transferred here; no local records have been moved or deleted.

Cloud screenshots will be parent-requested only, not captured automatically.

Student Management

Gradebook

Manually enter and review grades in your online account. Children see their own saved grades and feedback. Submitted papers are below. Automatic grading, quiz capture, course averages, and existing LAN grades are still being transferred.

Submitted papers & private files

Open a paper to review, zoom, rotate and download it. Record its score and feedback with Add Grade above. Automatic grading and importing existing LAN files are not enabled yet.

Subject Management

Choose which children receive each school link and set a daily time goal. Time is securely measured by the child app; curriculum lesson completion still comes from the school provider.

Math Coach

Not connected to cloud yet

Math Coach is still available in your current Admin app. Its existing screen and functions will be transferred here; no local records have been moved or deleted.

Learning Videos

Parent-approved YouTube links, including unlisted videos, organized by folder. Active videos are available to every child without recreational time limits or school-completion requirements. A computer-wide parent pause still applies. YouTube needs internet and may restrict playback; preview every new link. MP4 uploads, YouTube search and importing your existing LAN library are not part of this cloud test yet.

Calendar & Schedule

Family school calendar

Loading the family schedule…

SunMonTueWedThuFriSat

Vacations, holidays, and exceptions

An open-day exception uses your usual school hours. Individual subjects can have shorter hours, set under Subjects.

School check-in bonuses and late deductions are still available in the installed Admin app; they have not moved to this calendar yet.

Weekly Spelling

Create each child’s weekly list, monitor daily practice, and prepare them for the separately graded test in their book.

Practice is safe.Daily mistakes never cost coins. Friday’s practice pre-test uses the gentle policy: +5 for 100%, +3 for 90–99%, no change for 80–89%, and below 80% loses one coin per missed word (maximum 5). It never enters the gradebook; the scanned book test is the actual grade.
Optional, per child

Personal Spelling Coach

When a child misses a practice word, BodeeGuard remembers the letter pattern and gives that child a short, specific tip the next time it returns. Tips are never shown during a practice pre-test.

Per-child learning memory

Spelling Coach keeps each child’s practice mistakes and uses the original built-in hints. Cloud AI refinement is not enabled.

New Weekly Spelling List

Scan the printed pagePhoto extraction has not transferred yet. Enter and review the words below.
Use one word per line. Apostrophes and hyphens are supported; duplicates are removed when saved.

💰 Economy

Coin balances, reward redemptions, and typing progress for every student. Earlier records still need transfer.

Coin Balances

One coin represents about one minute of honest school effort. Practice and bonus rewards are intentionally small and capped. Use the +/- buttons to manually adjust.

Reward Catalog

Choose exactly what children can buy, how many coins it costs, and how often each reward may be redeemed. Hidden rewards stay in past receipts but disappear from the student Store.

Time boost stays banked until the child uses it Privilege / cash waits for parent fulfillment

Reward Redemptions

Time boosts are fulfilled automatically. Review family privileges and cash requests here, then mark each fulfilled or refund the student's coins.
